title: a new ruff finding on a Python file the branch touches

explain.what: ruff found something new in a Python file the branch touches; the finding names the ruff rule (LP/<code>).
explain.why: ruff is the project's own Python linter, with the project's own config (its merge base copy). It is a hard CI gate, so catching a new finding here saves the CI round.
explain.fix: Fix what the message says: `uv run --no-sync ruff check --fix <file>` applies the safe fixes, `ruff format <file>` the formatting. A finding that must stay needs a waiver for LP/<code>.

parse.what: ruff cannot parse a Python file the branch touches.
parse.why: A file that does not parse cannot be imported, and no other check can read it.
parse.fix: Fix the syntax error the message names, then run the check again.

config-changed.what: The branch edits ruff's config ([tool.ruff] in a pyproject.toml, or ruff.toml).
config-changed.why: The config says what ruff looks for; editing it is the cheapest way to clear a finding. The check lints with the merge base's config either way.
config-changed.fix: Keep the config as it is, or ask the owner: his waiver for LP/config-changed approves the rule change.
